## Day 5 — End-to-End Supervised Learning Mini-Project

Day 5 combined the complete supervised-learning workflow into a single
classification project using the Titanic dataset.

### Work completed

- Loaded and inspected a real classification dataset
- Defined the features and survival target
- Performed exploratory data analysis
- Examined missing values and class distribution
- Created a reproducible stratified train/test split
- Built preprocessing pipelines for numerical and categorical features
- Imputed missing values
- Applied one-hot encoding
- Standardized numerical features
- Prevented data leakage by fitting preprocessing on training data only
- Created a majority-class baseline
- Trained Logistic Regression
- Trained Random Forest
- Evaluated models using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC
- Generated confusion matrices and ROC curves
- Compared model performance
- Examined Random Forest feature importances
- Selected and justified the final model
- Documented project limitations

### Main deliverable

`notebooks/day05_supervised_learning_mini_project.ipynb`

- Python
- Pandas
